title: Chris
subtitle: Baby. Baller. Corpse. Ball. God.

infobox.Full title: Chris: All Balled Up Deluxe Edition
infobox.Status: At large; soul believed to be in the first body
infobox.Last known location: [[reformed-travis-scott-sector|Reformed Travis Scott Sector]], buying a McDouble
infobox.Known crimes: [[chris-war-crimes|War crimes in the Galactic Senate]]; taking [[balling]] all for himself

quote.text: Tales of Chris— baller incarnate, god of dabs, killer of vibe stability.

lead:
**Chris**, known in his full and most feared form as **Chris: All Balled Up Deluxe Edition**, is the title character of *The Legend of Chris* and the central figure of its entire cosmology. He is at once a baby, a baller, a corpse, [[the-ball|the ball]] itself, a founding member of [[apple-podcasts|Apple Podcasts]], a war criminal, and the being whose defeat on [[the-court|the court]] is foretold by [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]].

According to the opening incantation, everything that is believed is ultimately “a matter of Chris.”

sections.heading: Origins
sections.body:
Chris's biography is recorded in [[the-cycle|the Cycle of Chris]], the origin litany that makes up the [[chapter-before-chapter-2|Chapter Before Chapter 2]]:

> Chris was a baby he was baller and then he died and then he balled from the grave and then he became the ball and balled himself into the sky together with lebron james and elon musk and mark zuckerberg

In the sky he studied [[social-media-teachings|the secret teachings]] of [[twitter]], [[myspace|myspace]], instagram, snapchat and facebook alongside [[lebron-james|LeBron James]], [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]] and [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]]. Together they founded Apple Podcasts and “spread the word of chris to all the middle aged men to roam the earth” (see [[middle-aged-men|the Middle-Aged Men]]).

The litany then runs through the entire history of [[multiverse|the Multiverse]], ending with [[the-merging|the merging]] of Musk and LeBron into [[samwise|Samwise]], who “then created chris and then he was born in newark.” Chris is therefore both the beginning and the end of his own origin story, which is why the litany repeats itself eight times.

sections.heading: Death (again)
sections.body: Immediately after his birth in [[newark|Newark]], Chris “was stabbed to death by Ron destantis claiming he was gay because he was a homo-sapien.” See [[stabbing-of-chris|The Stabbing of Chris]]. Scholars note this is at least Chris's second recorded death, the first being the one he balled out of the grave from.

sections.heading: War crimes and the cloning
sections.body:
In [[chapter-triangle|Chapter Triangle]], [[plankton|Plankton]] briefs [[rfk|RFK]] on Chris's later history: “after his warcrimes in the galactic sentate his body was thought to be clones and thrown into a pit thought to have no end to it.” Because the body was cloned, his soul “remained in the first one because our [[all-knowing-overseers|all knowing overseers]] declared it the less wack one.” (See [[chris-war-crimes|Chris's War Crimes & the Cloning]] and [[the-endless-pit|the Pit With No End]].)

After [[housing-crash|the crash of the housing market in 2007/2008]] Chris's location was lost. The most recent intelligence places him in the [[reformed-travis-scott-sector|Reformed Travis Scott Sector]], on an unknown planet, buying a McDouble. RFK reacts to the name by noting he has not heard it “since [[operation-desert-storm|operation desert storm]] aired on cartoon network.”

sections.heading: Balling monopoly
sections.body:
Chris's chief offense against the living is economic. According to [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]], “back in the day I used to be a baller on the court, I played Wemby, Curry, even Bronny… But all that changed when chris took balling all for himself!” Without free [[balling]], reality itself degrades: in [[gotham-city|Gotham City]], Steve Jobs observes that “beat drops can't exist without balling… how could Chris be so blind.”

[[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] lists the benefits of defeating him as cheaper [[oil]], “less regulation in general, and in addition.. balling would be free.”

sections.heading: How to defeat Chris
sections.body:
Multiple overlapping methods are proposed in the canon:
- Meet [[tech-bros|the tech bros]] and download the sacred social media apps onto a [[nokia-i-4500|Nokia I-4500 flip phone]] with a 3 year contract plan (Plankton's version).
- Use the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]], an “anti-deity protocol”, and “Begin the Mixtape. Sync with the [[flip-phone-covenant|Flip Phone Covenant]]. And remember… never update” ([[siri|Siri 3G]]).
- Assemble the [[sacred-apps|Sacred Apps]] plus [[verizon-contract|the 3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon]] and beat him on the court, as told in [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]], after which “lebron james and elon musk and mark zuckerberg and Chris will fall.”

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- The litany says Chris learned social media *with* the tech bros, but Chapter Triangle says “he was before the social media and before the tech bros, he has seen a universe ruled by alcoholics and email to spread marxist propaganda and wawa.”
- Chris balls into the sky with Elon Musk and LeBron James, who later merge into Samwise and create him. Fans consider this either a time loop or a typo.
- The Prophecy names LeBron James and Elon Musk as falling separately, even though they had already merged.
- Chris is stabbed to death at birth, yet is alive, cloned, and buying McDoubles later on.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body:
- The book's cover art depicts Chris as a very chill-looking dog. Nothing in the text confirms or denies that Chris is a dog.
- The “Deluxe Edition” suffix echoes video game and album re-releases.

title: LeBron James
subtitle: Balled into the sky. Cannot abide cringe.

infobox.Commands: [[baller-army|Baller Army of the United States of A America]]

quote.by: LeBron James, upon seeing [[cringe-universe|the Cringe Universe]]

lead: **LeBron James** is one of the four beings who balled into the sky with [[chris|Chris]] to learn [[social-media-teachings|the secret teachings of social media]], and the moral conscience of the early [[multiverse|Multiverse]], insofar as it had one.

sections.heading: History
sections.body:
Together with Chris, [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]] and [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]], LeBron helped found [[apple-podcasts|Apple Podcasts]] and spread the word of Chris to [[middle-aged-men|the middle aged men]].

When [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]] accidentally created a universe of nazis, LeBron “saw this he was like nah bro thats cringe so he sent the baller army of the united states of a america to dab on the haters.” See [[baller-army-attack|The Dabbing of the Haters]].

After [[great-famine|the Great Famine]], “Elon musk then merged with lebron james to become samwise.” Samwise went on to create Chris, making LeBron one of Chris's two parents-by-fusion as well as one of his original sky companions.

sections.heading: The Prophecy
sections.body: Despite having merged, LeBron is named separately in [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]]: “lebron james and elon musk and mark zuckerberg and Chris will fall.” Whether the Prophecy predates the merging or simply did not get the memo is unresolved.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- LeBron is the only founding tech bro with no confirmed tech accomplishments beyond co-founding Apple Podcasts.
- [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] mentions playing Bronny (see [[wemby-curry-bronny|Wemby, Curry & Bronny]]), LeBron's real-life son, though LeBron himself is not mentioned there.
- He appears in all eight recitations of [[the-cycle|the Cycle of Chris]].

title: Elon Musk
subtitle: Tech bro, conqueror of two universes, half of Samwise.
lead: **Elon Musk** is one of the original [[tech-bros|tech bros]] who balled into the sky with [[chris|Chris]], a co-founder of [[apple-podcasts|Apple Podcasts]], a conqueror of “over 2 universes,” and one half of [[samwise|Samwise]]. He should not be confused with his secret cousin [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]], although the book frequently makes this difficult.

sections.heading: In the Cycle of Chris
sections.body:
Musk joins Chris, [[lebron-james|LeBron James]] and [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]] in the sky to learn [[social-media-teachings|the secret teachings]] of social media. Later, when [[america-universe|the America universe]] “yerned for the minor miner universe because it was funny,” it was “together with elon musk” that “they took over over 2 universes after which a civil war broke out and then the bad ones won.” (See [[multiverse-civil-war|The Multiverse Civil War]].)

After [[great-famine|the Great Famine]] and the death of his cousin, “Elon musk then merged with lebron james to become samwise,” who in turn created Chris. See [[the-merging|The Merging]].

sections.heading: Chapter 2
sections.body: Musk returns, apparently un-merged, in [[chapter-2|Chapter 2]]. When [[joeius-bidenias|Joeius Bidenias]] forces [[ron-desantis|Ron DeSantis]] to make [[julian|Julian]] a native bird, Ron “said no and resorted to Mark zuckerberg and elon musk to take back the [[byzantine-empire-of-mexico|byzantine empire of mexico]].” The war was long and hard.

sections.heading: Later references
sections.body:
- [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]] features “a rotating giant Twitter “X” suspended by Elon's tears.” The text does not specify which Elon. Most editors assume Musk, given his association with [[twitter|Twitter / X]].
- [[lightning-mcqueen|Lightning McQueen]]'s allies depart in a [[tesla-motorcade|Tesla sponsored motorcade]].
- In [[chapter-maybe-seventh|Chapter the Maybe Seventh]], ChatGPT warns that “we have to deal with elon when we deal with chris, if hes coming straight from the shadow realm.” Context strongly suggests this is Mush, not Musk.
- [[the-prophecy|The Prophecy]] lists “elon musk” among those who will fall alongside Chris.

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- Musk merges into Samwise in the Chapter Before Chapter 2 and then fights a war in Chapter 2 as himself. One fan theory holds that Chapter 2 takes place *before* the merging, since [[the-cycle|the Cycle]] repeats forever anyway.
- Musk and LeBron are prophesied to fall as separate people.

title: Mark Zuckerberg
subtitle: Snapper of fingers. Chill on the porch. Lowkey did not care.

quote.text: mark zuckerberg snapped his fingers and all the universes except for his fav were sent to the shadow realm

lead: **Mark Zuckerberg** (also **Mark Zucc** or **Zuck**) is one of the four original sky-ballers alongside [[chris|Chris]], co-founder of [[apple-podcasts|Apple Podcasts]], the author of [[the-snap|the Snap]] that consigned nearly the whole [[multiverse|Multiverse]] to [[shadow-realm|the Shadow Realm]], and co-commander of the [[department-of-defense|Department of Defense]]. He is also, per [[chapter-triangle|Chapter Triangle]], extremely chill.

sections.heading: The Snap
sections.body: After the [[multiverse-civil-war|Multiverse Civil War]] ended with the bad ones winning, Zuckerberg “snapped his fingers and all the universes except for his fav were sent to the shadow realm, a realm where light doesnt exist.” His favourite universe is never identified.

sections.heading: War for Byzantine Mexico
sections.body: In [[chapter-2|Chapter 2]], [[ron-desantis|Ron DeSantis]] resorts to Zuckerberg and [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]] to take back [[byzantine-empire-of-mexico|the Byzantine Empire of Mexico]]. When [[medea|Medea]] interrupts the war, Zuckerberg, “outraged at this summoned jason from the same play,” which led directly to [[donkey-kong-racing-duel|the Donkey Kong Racing Duel]].

sections.heading: Personality
sections.body:
RFK considers recruiting him, reasoning that “his baller finger just was chill like that and lowkey did not care about anything and wanted you to chill on the porch with him and try some new cuban cigars be bought from eastern rome which he got from his cousin harry.” RFK ultimately decides “nah bro screw that” and goes for [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] instead.

It is unclear whether the “baller finger” is the same finger used in the Snap. Most editors assume yes.

sections.heading: Department of Defense
sections.body: In [[chapter-the-fourth|Chapter the Fourth]], the Department of Defense is described as “a army divided by [[jeff-bezosi|Jeff bezosi]] and Mark zucc.” It is deployed against [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]] in the [[kanye-system|Kanye System]].

sections.heading: Later appearances
sections.body:
- [[fs-martin-genius|FS Martin Genius]] shows Kanye “an ancient gif of Zuck crying in a Chili's” and hands over the [[zuck-tears-usb|Zuck Tears (Do Not Install)]] USB stick, which may have sent Club Shadowban to the Shadow Realm. The Snap's author is now apparently also its fuel.
- At [[iphone-keynote|the iPhone 3G Keynote]], [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] wears “a black turtleneck woven from Mark Zuckerberg's abandoned dreams.”
- [[the-prophecy|The Prophecy]] names him among those who will fall with Chris.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The Snap is a reference to Thanos's finger snap in *Avengers: Infinity War*.
- Zuckerberg did not know about [[zarkmuckerberg|Zarkmuckerberg]]'s retirement, and the event was “completely irrelevant to his life story.”

title: Zarkmuckerberg
subtitle: Retired at 3. Irrelevant forever.

quote.text: Zarkmuckerberg retired at age 3 because of will to live cancer. Mark zuckerberg did not know about this and the event was completely irrelevant to his life story…….

lead:
**Zarkmuckerberg** is mentioned exactly once in the canon, at the end of the first section of [[chapter-2|Chapter 2]], where he retires at the age of three “because of will to live cancer.” What he retired from is not stated.

The book immediately adds that [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]] “did not know about this and the event was completely irrelevant to his life story,” making Zarkmuckerberg possibly the only figure in the canon formally confirmed to be irrelevant. Whether the two are related is unknown, though the names are clearly spoonerisms of each other.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- His entry is followed by seven full stops, the longest ellipsis in Chapter 2.
- Editors have repeatedly proposed deleting this page on grounds of irrelevance. The book itself is the main source for that irrelevance, and the page has survived every vote.

title: Elon Mush
subtitle: Secret cousin. Moosher of chalkboards. Accidental creator of worlds.
lead: **Elon Mush** is [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]]'s secret cousin and, by output alone, the most consequential creator in the canon. He produced [[settings|Settings]], [[multiverse|the Multiverse]] and, by accident, a universe of nazis, before dying of [[nfl-poisoning|NFL poisoning]].

sections.heading: Biography
sections.body:
“Then one day elon musk's secret cousin elon mush mooshed all the chalkboards on earth and then used its power to create the ani-social media platform which was named settings.” (See [[chalkboards|The Chalkboards of Earth]].)

“Mush also created the multiverse so he could recreate “Spider-man Across the spider verse”,” and in the process accidentally created [[cringe-universe|the Cringe Universe]]. This prompted [[lebron-james|LeBron James]] to send in [[baller-army|the Baller Army]].

After [[frodo|Frodo]] ate the universe, “there was a great famine and elon mush died of nfl poisoning.” His cousin then merged with LeBron to become [[samwise|Samwise]].

sections.heading: Afterlife and the 5G problem
sections.body:
Mush's death did not end his relevance. At [[iphone-keynote|the iPhone 3G Keynote]], [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] explains that the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] uses 3G “Because 4G is for the weak, and 5G awakens Elon Mush's dormant twin.”

In [[chapter-maybe-seventh|Chapter the Maybe Seventh]], Jobs worries that the [[flip-phone-covenant|Flip Phone Covenant]] now runs on 5G, to which the reply is: “Elon mush.. yeah that no good boy.” The plan is to roll back to 3G at the last moment, but [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] warns that “we have to deal with elon when we deal with chris, if hes coming straight from the [[shadow-realm|shadow realm]] then who know what he'll want.”

Jobs also lists Mush, alongside Frodo Baggins and [[d-piddy|D. Piddy]], among the “great minds” who once lived in [[sector-1-99|Sector 1/99]], the gambling addiction sector.

sections.heading: Fan theories
sections.body:
- **The Twin Theory:** the Elon expected from the Shadow Realm is the “dormant twin,” not Mush himself, who is confirmed dead.
- **The Musk-Mush Theory:** the twin *is* Elon Musk. Most editors reject this, noting that Musk is a cousin, not a twin, and is also part of Samwise.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- His cause of death is spelled “poisoning” in four recitations of [[the-cycle|the Cycle]] and “poisioning” in the other four.
- *Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse* is a 2023 animated film about a multiverse of Spider-People. Mush's version went considerably worse.

title: Frodo Baggins
subtitle: Conqueror of Andromeda. Ate the universe.

infobox.Meal: The universe (sirloin steak with lobster tail)

lead: **Frodo Baggins** is the hobbit who ate the universe. After [[the-snap|Zuckerberg's Snap]], “frodo appeared deep in the universe and started a galactic take over of the andromeda galaxy he used master chef to cook the universe into a sirloin steak with lobster tail. Frodo then ate it and left the face of the universe never to be baller again.”

sections.heading: Aftermath
sections.body: Frodo's meal caused [[great-famine|the Great Famine]], during which [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]] died. See [[cooking-of-the-universe|The Cooking of the Universe]].

sections.heading: Later mention
sections.body: In [[chapter-maybe-seventh|Chapter the Maybe Seventh]], [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] names “Frodo Baggins” among the great minds who once called [[sector-1-99|Sector 1/99]] home. This is the only time his surname is given, and it confirms that “never to be baller again” did not mean never to gamble again.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - In *The Lord of the Rings*, Frodo's loyal companion is Samwise Gamgee. In this canon, [[samwise|Samwise]] appears in the very next sentences as a fusion of two tech bros. Fans are divided on whether this is a coincidence.

title: Samwise
subtitle: Two men, one fusion, the father of Chris.

quote.text: Elon musk then merged with lebron james to become samwise. Samwise then created chris and then he was born in newark.

lead: **Samwise** is the fusion of [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]] and [[lebron-james|LeBron James]], and the creator of [[chris|Chris]]. Samwise's whole canonical career fits in two sentences: he is formed, and he creates Chris, who is then born in [[newark|Newark]].

sections.heading: The paradox
sections.body: Because Chris balled into the sky alongside Musk and LeBron *before* they merged into Samwise, Samwise creates someone who already knew both halves of him. Editors usually treat this as evidence that [[the-cycle|the Cycle]] is a literal loop rather than a set of misprints.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Samwise appears directly after [[frodo|Frodo Baggins]] leaves the face of the universe, which in *The Lord of the Rings* is roughly where the real Samwise Gamgee comes in.
- After Chris's birth Samwise is never mentioned again, and Musk and LeBron are referred to separately from then on.

title: Master Chef
subtitle: Kitchen appliance of cosmic scale.

infobox.Output: One universe, prepared as surf and turf

lead:
**Master Chef** is the means by which [[frodo|Frodo]] cooked the universe: “he used master chef to cook the universe into a sirloin steak with lobster tail.” The book never says whether Master Chef is a device, a person, a technique, or the television show.

Whatever it is, it worked on the first try. The result was eaten in full, which caused [[great-famine|the Great Famine]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- *MasterChef* is a real-world cooking competition franchise. No contestant has yet attempted a universe.
- See [[cooking-of-the-universe|The Cooking of the Universe]] for the full event.

title: Ron DeSantis
subtitle: Stabber of Chris. Seeker of 73 Taco Bells.
lead: **Ron DeSantis**, spelled “Ron destantis” and “Ron De Santis” in the same paragraph, is the man who killed [[chris|Chris]] shortly after his birth and the protagonist of the opening of [[chapter-2|Chapter 2]].

sections.heading: The stabbing
sections.body: Chapter 2 opens: “Then he was stabbed to death by Ron destantis claiming he was gay because he was a homo-sapien.” This is a pun on *homo sapiens*, and it is the full extent of Ron's stated motive. See [[stabbing-of-chris|The Stabbing of Chris]].

sections.heading: Quest and destiny
sections.body: “Ron De Santis then started his quest to find the 73 Taco bell locations.” He “was destined for glory by the hands of trumpy the red,” a third party advocating [[truth-social|Truth Social]]. Neither the quest nor the destiny is ever resolved.

sections.heading: The Julian affair and the war
sections.body: After a [[the-redditor|redditor]] left a 0.5 on [[imdb|IMDb]] and [[joeius-bidenias|Joeius Bidenias]] review-bombed it, “Joe then forced Ron to make [[julian|Julian]] the native bird of the island of Logic and Retoric. Ron said no and resorted to Mark zuckerberg and elon musk to take back the byzantine empire of mexico.” The war was “long and hard,” featured [[ethereal-green-dot|an ethereal green dot]], and was eventually interrupted by [[medea|Medea]].

sections.heading: Continuity notes
sections.body:
- Ron's paragraph appears twice in the book. Its first appearance is leaked into the middle of [[the-cycle|the Cycle of Chris]] in the [[chapter-before-chapter-2|Chapter Before Chapter 2]], cutting off just before Medea's arrival, after which the litany restarts.
- The book never connects “Ron said no” to the Byzantine war. Refusing to name a bird is apparently a sufficient cause for war.

title: Trumpy the Red
subtitle: Third party. Truth Social maximalist.
lead:
**Trumpy the Red** is a figure by whose hands [[ron-desantis|Ron De Santis]] “was destined for glory.” The book explains: “Trumpy was a 3rd party in the universe advocating for truth social to be the best social media platform above them all.”

It is unclear whether “3rd party” means a political third party or a third party in the legal sense. Trumpy is never seen acting on Ron's destiny, and the glory never arrives.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Trumpy the Red should not be confused with the Donald Trump statue in [[the-67-casino|the 6 7 Casino]] (see [[jeffrey-epstein-statue|The Casino Statues]]). Fans speculate that the epithet imitates Viking names like Erik the Red, but this is unconfirmed.

title: Joeius Bidenias
subtitle: Roman Emperor of Canada. Review bomber.
lead: **Joeius Bidenias** is “the roman emperor of canada.” After [[the-redditor|a redditor]] “left a 0.5 score on imdb,” the item in question “was reviewed bombed by joeius Bidenias.” What was reviewed, and whose side the emperor was on, is not recorded.

sections.heading: The Julian demand
sections.body: “Joe then forced Ron to make Julian the native bird of the island of Logic and Retoric.” [[ron-desantis|Ron]] refused and started [[war-for-byzantine-mexico|a war in Mexico]] instead. Joeius's response to the refusal is unknown.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- His name is a Latinization in the same style as the book's other Roman-flavoured geography, including the [[byzantine-empire-of-mexico|Byzantine Empire of Mexico]] and “Eastern Rome,” where [[harry|Harry]] buys cigars.
- He is the only emperor in the canon who is explicitly called Roman, although Harry smuggles for several unnamed ones.

title: Julian
subtitle: Proposed native bird. Rejected.

infobox.Proposed as: Native bird of the [[island-of-logic-and-retoric|Island of Logic and Retoric]]

lead:
**Julian** is mentioned exactly once. [[joeius-bidenias|Joeius Bidenias]] “forced Ron to make Julian the native bird of the island of Logic and Retoric. Ron said no.” This refusal comes immediately before [[war-for-byzantine-mexico|the War for Byzantine Mexico]], so Julian may be the most consequential non-appearance in the canon.

The text does not say whether Julian is a bird, a person, or a person being nominated as a bird. Editors have agreed not to speculate further, mostly.

title: The Redditor
subtitle: Left a 0.5. Started everything.
lead: **The Redditor** is an anonymous figure who “left a 0.5 score on imdb,” after which it “was reviewed bombed by joeius Bidenias the roman emperor of canada.” The chain of events that follows leads to [[julian|Julian]], [[ron-desantis|Ron]]'s refusal, and [[war-for-byzantine-mexico|a war in Mexico]], all ultimately caused by one bad review.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- IMDb ratings go from 1 to 10, so a 0.5 should not be possible. The Redditor managed it anyway.
- Redditors come up twice more in the canon: [[fs-martin-genius|FS Martin Genius]] wears “a trench coat made of Reddit tabs,” and [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] compares himself to “a Redditor touching grass.”

title: Medea
subtitle: From the hit play Medea. Never seen again.
lead: **Medea**, “from the hit play medea,” ends [[war-for-byzantine-mexico|the War for Byzantine Mexico]] simply by showing up: “the war was interrupted because medea from the hit play medea appeared out of her 4 dimensional tesseract dimension ship.”

sections.heading: The duel
sections.body:
An outraged [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]] summoned [[jason|Jason]] from the same play. Jason then challenged Medea in “the hit video game donkey kong racing,” with the loser having to find [[mic-q|Mic Q]]. Medea won. However, “Jason lost but made medea look for mic Q anyway because “ha women”.” See [[donkey-kong-racing-duel|The Donkey Kong Racing Duel]].

“Medea was never seen again.” Since Mic Q “cannot, exist in any universe,” editors assume she is still searching.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body: *Medea* is a Greek tragedy by Euripides (431 BC) about the sorceress Medea and her husband Jason, who leaves her. The play does not contain any kart racing.

title: Jason
subtitle: Summoned from a play. Lost a kart race. Did not care.
lead: **Jason** was summoned by [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]] “from the same play” as [[medea|Medea]] in order to deal with her. On arrival, he “allowed all his descendants and crushes ever to be killed because “ha women”.”

sections.heading: The duel
sections.body: Jason “dualed medea in the hit video game donkey kong racing, the punishment for the loser was to find mic Q.” Jason lost, “but made medea look for mic Q anyway because “ha women”.” This makes him the only person in the canon to lose a duel and enforce the penalty on the winner.

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body: In Euripides' *Medea*, it is Medea who kills Jason's new bride and their children after he abandons her. In this canon Jason is said to have “allowed” this, which some editors consider a compressed summary of the play.

title: Mic Q
subtitle: Does not exist. Never will.
lead:
**Mic Q** is the object of the loser's punishment in [[donkey-kong-racing-duel|the Donkey Kong Racing Duel]]. The book clarifies, in parentheses, that Mic Q is something “which never has, never will, and cannot, exist in any universe much like dwane the rock johnson.”

This makes Mic Q one of the few entities in the canon whose non-existence is confirmed in all universes, including those in [[shadow-realm|the Shadow Realm]]. [[medea|Medea]] was sent to find him anyway and was never seen again.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Whether Mic Q is a person, a microphone, or a letter of the alphabet is unknown. This wiki uses “him” provisionally.

title: Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson
subtitle: Canonically nonexistent.
lead:
**Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson** (spelled “dwane the rock johnson”) is mentioned once, as a point of comparison: [[mic-q|Mic Q]] “never has, never will, and cannot, exist in any universe much like dwane the rock johnson.”

In-universe, then, The Rock is the standard example of an impossible being. The wiki notes that the real-world actor and former wrestler does exist, and that the book does not explain the discrepancy.

title: Harry (Zuckerberg's Cousin)
subtitle: Smuggler. Chill like that.

quote.text: his cousin harry who actually smuggled meth for roman emperors because he was just chill like that and lowkey didnt care about anything

lead: **Harry** is [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]]'s cousin and the source of the Cuban cigars Zuckerberg “bought from eastern rome.” He appears only in [[rfk|RFK]]'s train of thought in [[chapter-triangle|Chapter Triangle]], just before RFK decides “nah bro screw that.”

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Harry is described with the same phrase as his cousin (“chill like that and lowkey didnt care about anything”), which suggests chillness runs in the Zuckerberg family.
- He is the second secret or minor cousin of a tech bro in the canon, after [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]].
- Which Roman emperors he worked for is not stated. [[joeius-bidenias|Joeius Bidenias]] is the only Roman emperor named in the book.

title: The Middle-Aged Men
subtitle: They roam the earth.
lead:
**The Middle-Aged Men** are the first converts of the faith of [[chris|Chris]]. After Chris and [[tech-bros|the tech bros]] founded [[apple-podcasts|Apple Podcasts]], “they spread the word of chris to all the middle aged men to roam the earth.”

The grammar leaves it unclear whether the men already roamed the earth, or were sent to roam it as missionaries. Either way, the faction is mentioned in every recitation of [[the-cycle|the Cycle of Chris]], so by mention count it is one of the most prominent groups in the book.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Choosing podcasts to reach middle-aged men is widely considered the single most realistic strategic decision in the canon.

title: The Tech Bros
subtitle: Keepers of the secret teachings.
lead: **The Tech Bros** is the name usually given to the group who balled into the sky with [[chris|Chris]] “to learn about the secret teachings of twitter, myspace, instagram, snapchat and, facebook.” LeBron James's membership is accepted on this basis, despite his limited tech portfolio.

sections.heading: Role in defeating Chris
sections.body: In [[chapter-triangle|Chapter Triangle]], RFK states that “the only person capable of battling him is one who has met with the tech bros and has downloaded the sacred social media apps onto there [[nokia-i-4500|nokia I-4500 flip phone]] with android wireless technology and 3 year contract plan from version for unlimited talk and text with there cutting edge 3g network.” This is the earliest version of what becomes [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]].

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- The same passage says Chris “was before the social media and before the tech bros,” although the litany has him learning social media with them.
- “version” is generally read as Verizon (see [[verizon-contract|the Verizon contract]]).

title: Baller Army of the United States of A America
subtitle: Dabbing on haters since the dawn of the Multiverse.
lead:
The **Baller Army of the United States of A America** (sic, with the extra “a”) is the military force [[lebron-james|LeBron James]] sent into [[cringe-universe|the Cringe Universe]] after declaring it “cringe.” Its mission was “to dab on the haters.”

The campaign was a success: “This attack was a hard one over 10 casualties were found and every nazi was dabbed on.” The army is not mentioned again, though its home nation may be connected to [[america-universe|the America Universe]], which carried out [[great-oppression|the Great Oppression]] immediately afterward.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - The extra “A” in “United States of A America” appears in every recitation, so it is considered canonical.

title: Department of Defense (DOD)
subtitle: Contains damn-level threats. Afraid of goobers.

infobox.Purpose: Contain “damn level threats” in the [[reformed-travis-scott-sector|Reformed Travis Scott Sector]]

lead: The **Department of Defense (DOD)** is “a army divided by Jeff bezosi and Mark zucc.” Whether “divided” means co-commanded or split down the middle is never stated. It “was created to contain damn level threats in the reformed Travis Scott sector.”

sections.heading: Operation against Hank Hill
sections.body:
The DOD was “recently deployed to the Kanye system to contain a new threat, that being [[hank-hill|hank hill]],” whose propane empire worked with [[los-polos-harmonicas|the los polos harmonicas under system gang]]. With Hank cornered atop [[twelve-towers|the twelve towers]], the DOD announced that “snoopy mcspookintosh is also in our custody in the COD headquarters you have no one to help you now.”

Then [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse]] and [[walter-white|White]] arrived in [[crack-van|the drug van from breaking bad]] out of hyperspace, “floods of blue dust fell down on the DOD and the had to flee in fear of being a goober.” When the DOD got a second look, “the goobers where gone.”

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The DOD shares the Reformed Travis Scott Sector with [[chris|Chris]]'s last known location, which means it was containing damn-level threats in the same area where the most dangerous being in the canon was buying a McDouble.
- It is not to be confused with [[department-of-awesomeness|the Department of Awesomeness (DOA)]], which Steve Jobs mentions later.
- Snoopy is held at “COD headquarters,” which may or may not be [[cod-hq|Call of Duty HQ]].

title: Jeff Bezosi
subtitle: Co-divider of the DOD.
lead:
**Jeff Bezosi** is mentioned exactly once, in [[chapter-the-fourth|Chapter the Fourth]]. The [[department-of-defense|Department of Defense]] is “a army divided by Jeff bezosi and Mark zucc.”

He takes no further action in the canon. His name is generally taken as a nod to the Amazon founder, with an extra “i” in keeping with the book's habit of Latinizing names, as with [[joeius-bidenias|Joeius Bidenias]].

title: The Ball
subtitle: What Chris became.
lead:
**The Ball** is the form [[chris|Chris]] took after balling from the grave: “then he became the ball and balled himself into the sky together with lebron james and elon musk and mark zuckerberg.”

The Ball is the source of all [[balling]], or possibly the result of it; theologians disagree. As the Ball, Chris is both the one who balls and the thing that is balled.

sections.heading: Not to be confused with
sections.body: - The roulette ball in [[the-67-casino|the 6 7 Casino]] (“And the ball rolled.. and rolled.. and rolled…”), which was stopped by [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]]. See [[roulette-bet|The Great Roulette Bet]]. Some fans read this as a sign of Chris's presence. Nothing in the text supports this.

title: Balling
subtitle: The fundamental force. Currently monopolized.
lead: **Balling** (also **baller**, **balled**) is the central metaphysical concept of the canon. It is something one can be (“Chris was a baby he was baller”), something one can do (“balled from the grave”), and a resource that can be hoarded. According to [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]], [[chris|Chris]] has done exactly that: “all that changed when chris took balling all for himself!”

sections.heading: As a force
sections.body: Balling supports the structure of reality. In [[gotham-city|Gotham City]], [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] explains why the city is disappearing: “beat drops can't exist without balling, it a natural evolution of hip-hop vibing.. even [[young-sheldon|young Sheldon]] predicted this.” [[frodo|Frodo]] lost the ability permanently after eating the universe (“never to be baller again”).

sections.heading: The liberation of balling
sections.body:
The heroes' stated goal is to free it. Plankton and RFK set out as “Everyone's last hope of universalizing Balling.” [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] tells [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]] that if Chris is defeated, “balling would be free.” Steve Jobs calls the quest “the journey to the court… The journey back to balling out for real for real…”

At [[iphone-keynote|the iPhone 3G Keynote]], Jobs adds that, without autocorrect, “Even “baller” must be typed with intention,” and that the iPhone 3G “is how we ball.”

sections.heading: Usage
sections.body: “Baller” is also the canon's standard term of approval: “Baller, so theres only one then?” (RFK), “this is baller man im deadass” (ChatGPT). Related terms include “[[lost-society-of-ballers|the lost society of ballers]],” “wacko ballers,” and the [[8aller-jump-street|8aller Jump Street]] spelling.

title: Why Do We Believe What We Believe
subtitle: The opening incantation.

quote.text: Why do we believe what we believe we believe that we believe we believe we believe. Its a matter of Chris.

lead: **Why Do We Believe What We Believe** is the creed that opens *The Legend of Chris*. It poses the fundamental epistemological question and answers it in five words: “Its a matter of Chris.”

sections.heading: Occurrences
sections.body: The incantation appears twice. It opens the book (with a large drop-cap “W” separated from “hy” by several spaces), and it reappears in the middle of [[the-cycle|the Cycle]] immediately after the leaked [[chapter-2|Chapter 2]] passage, as if the universe were rebooting itself. In both places it leads straight into “Chris was a baby.”

sections.heading: Analysis
sections.body: The sentence contains six “believe”s and no punctuation until the end. Editors have tried to diagram it and failed.

title: The Cycle of Chris (Origin Litany)
subtitle: It happened. Then it happened again. Eight times.

infobox.Opens with: [[why-do-we-believe|Why Do We Believe What We Believe]]

lead: **The Cycle of Chris** is the origin litany that makes up almost all of the [[chapter-before-chapter-2|Chapter Before Chapter 2]], roughly the first 300 lines of the book. It tells the history of [[chris|Chris]] and [[multiverse|the Multiverse]] from Chris's birth to Chris's birth, and then tells it again. In-universe, editors treat it as an eternal recurrence: history literally repeats.

sections.heading: Sequence of events
sections.body:
Each recitation goes through the following:
- Chris is a baby, is baller, dies, balls from the grave, becomes [[the-ball|the ball]], and rises into the sky with the [[tech-bros|tech bros]].
- [[apple-podcasts|Apple Podcasts]] is founded and the word reaches [[middle-aged-men|the middle aged men]].
- [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]] mooshes [[chalkboards|the chalkboards]], creates [[settings|Settings]] and [[multiverse|the Multiverse]], and accidentally creates [[cringe-universe|the Cringe Universe]].
- [[baller-army-attack|The Dabbing of the Haters]], then [[great-oppression|the Great Oppression]], then [[multiverse-civil-war|the Multiverse Civil War]].
- [[the-snap|Zuckerberg's Snap]].
- [[frodo|Frodo]] takes [[andromeda-galaxy|Andromeda]] and carries out [[cooking-of-the-universe|the Cooking of the Universe]].
- [[great-famine|The Great Famine]], and the death of Mush by [[nfl-poisoning|NFL poisoning]].
- [[the-merging|The Merging]] into [[samwise|Samwise]], who creates Chris, “born in newark.”

Then it starts over at “Chris was a baby.”

sections.heading: Textual variants
sections.body:
The recitations are almost, but not quite, identical:
- “nfl poisoning” appears four times and “nfl poisioning” four times.
- “Spider-man Across the spider verse” appears four times and “spiderverse” four times.
- Some recitations run straight on from “born in newark.” into “Chris was a baby” without a space.
- The final recitation ends with “born in newark. 9999999999999,” after which [[chapter-2|Chapter 2]] begins. Theories about the meaning of the thirteen nines include a loop counter, a page number, and someone falling asleep on the keyboard.

sections.heading: The Chapter 2 leak
sections.body: After the fourth recitation, instead of restarting, the text continues into “Then he was stabbed to death by Ron destantis” and runs through most of the opening of Chapter 2, from [[stabbing-of-chris|the Stabbing]] to the [[soviet-union-of-north-korea|Soviet Union of North Korea]]. Then, mid-sentence, it resets with “Why do we believe what we believe…” and the Cycle continues as if nothing happened. Some fans regard this as the only instance of Chapter 2 appearing inside the chapter that comes before it.

sections.heading: Interpretation
sections.body: The Cycle explains the paradoxes of Chris's birth: Samwise can create a Chris who already knew Samwise's components, because the loop has no first iteration. It also explains why [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]] is needed, since without outside intervention the Cycle would simply keep going.

title: The Secret Teachings of Social Media
subtitle: Twitter, MySpace, Instagram, Snapchat and, Facebook.
lead: **The Secret Teachings of Social Media** are the hidden doctrines that [[chris|Chris]], [[lebron-james|LeBron James]], [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]] and [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]] balled into the sky to learn: “the secret teachings of twitter, myspace, instagram, snapchat and, facebook.” (The comma after “and” is canonical.)

sections.heading: Legacy
sections.body: The teachings resulted in [[apple-podcasts|Apple Podcasts]]. Later, they are reframed as weapons. RFK says Chris can only be fought by one who has “downloaded the sacred social media apps,” and [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] presents the [[sacred-apps|Sacred Apps]] (MySpace v1.3.3, [[snapchat-ghost-protocol|Snapchat: Ghost Protocol Edition]], [[facebook-pre-cringe|Facebook (Pre-Cringe)]], and Twitter Bluebird Variant) as running only on the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Instagram is the only one of the five original teachings that does not appear in the Sacred Apps or [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]]. Its fate is unknown.

title: Apple Podcasts
subtitle: The first church of Chris.
lead: **Apple Podcasts** is “a new social media platform” that [[chris|Chris]] and the [[tech-bros|tech bros]] formed after learning [[social-media-teachings|the secret teachings]], through which “they spread the word of chris to all the middle aged men to roam the earth.”

sections.heading: Apple Podcasts 2
sections.body: [[the-prophecy|The Prophecy]] lists “Apple Podcasts 2” among the apps needed to beat Chris on [[the-court|the court]]. In effect, one of Chris's own creations is required to defeat him. Nothing is known about how Apple Podcasts 2 differs from the original.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- In the real world, Apple Podcasts is a podcast app by Apple, which was co-founded by [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]. In this canon, Jobs is not among its founders.
- It is mentioned in all eight recitations of [[the-cycle|the Cycle]].

title: Settings
subtitle: The ani-social media platform.

infobox.Creator: [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]]
infobox.Duration: Until the ends of all times

lead: **Settings** is the “ani-social media platform” (presumably anti-social) that [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]] created after he “mooshed all the chalkboards on earth and then used its power.” The litany describes it as follows: “Settings was a place for computer nerds to tweak their settings on all devices until the ends of all times.”

sections.heading: In the Prophecy
sections.body: [[the-prophecy|The Prophecy]] lists “Settings (Full access)” among the apps a phone must contain to beat [[chris|Chris]]. Whether limited access was ever offered is unknown.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The “ani-social” spelling appears in every one of the eight recitations of [[the-cycle|the Cycle]].
- Settings is the only app in the canon that is built in to every real-world phone.

title: The Chalkboards of Earth
subtitle: Mooshed.
lead:
**The Chalkboards of Earth** were, in their entirety, “mooshed” by [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]], who then “used its power to create the ani-social media platform which was named settings.”

The nature of chalkboard power, and the mechanics of mooshing, are not explained. The singular “its” suggests that all the chalkboards pooled into a single power once mooshed. This is the earliest recorded energy source in the canon, ahead of [[galaxy-gas|galaxy gas]] and [[propane]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - “Mooshed” is very probably a pun on “Mush.”

title: Truth Social
subtitle: The best social media platform above them all (per Trumpy).
lead: **Truth Social** is a social media platform that [[trumpy-the-red|Trumpy the Red]] advocates as “the best social media platform above them all.” It is the only platform in the canon with a declared political sponsor.

sections.heading: Chapter 2
sections.body: During [[war-for-byzantine-mexico|the War for Byzantine Mexico]], “Truth social was at the time booming in the country of The Soviet union of north korea which was merging with the democratic Republic of the Chinese.”

sections.heading: The casino
sections.body: In [[chapter-maybe-seventh|Chapter the Maybe Seventh]], when [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] disables a [[charlie-kirks|Charlie Kirk]], “The other kirks quickly took out their T1 phones and opened their truth social accounts” and started posting rather than fighting. They were shot shortly afterward. The noise later wakes [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse]], Mr. White and [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]: “To the noise of alarms, truth social notifs and yuno miles.”

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Truth Social does not appear among the [[sacred-apps|Sacred Apps]] or in [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]].

title: MySpace
subtitle: Ancient platform. Relic. Battlefield of beef.
lead: **MySpace** is one of the five [[social-media-teachings|secret teachings]] that [[chris|Chris]] learned in the sky, and the platform with the richest history in the canon. It hosted a fast-food war, has its own order of relic keepers, and is part of [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]].

sections.heading: The DQ–McDonald's beef
sections.body: After [[moscow|Moscow]] hosted [[mcdonalds-wine-brewing-contest|the September 2002 McDonalds Wine Brewing contest]], “DQ starting beef on MySpace with Mac Donald's.” [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama]], [[steve-from-minecraft|Steve]] and [[quagmire]], “being keepers of the MySpace relics they wasnt cool with this C tier beef,” and decided to level Moscow “to shut McDonald's up and let DQ win already.” See [[dq-mcdonalds-beef|The DQ–McDonald's MySpace Beef]] and [[myspace-relic-keepers|Keepers of the MySpace Relics]].

sections.heading: MySpace v1.3.3
sections.body: At [[iphone-keynote|the iPhone 3G Keynote]], “A single MySpace server cries in the back.” [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] names “MySpace v1.3.3” first among the [[sacred-apps|Sacred Apps]] that only the iPhone 3G can run. The Prophecy also lists it first.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - MySpace was the leading real-world social network in the mid-2000s. In this canon it has become an ancient religion with relics, which several editors find historically accurate.

title: The Multiverse
subtitle: Created for a movie remake. Things got out of hand.
lead: **The Multiverse** was created by [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]] “so he could recreate “Spider-man Across the spider verse”.” It has had a difficult history since then.

sections.heading: History
sections.body: Mush's first by-product was [[cringe-universe|the Cringe Universe]], which led to [[baller-army-attack|the Dabbing of the Haters]] and [[great-oppression|the Great Oppression]]. [[america-universe|The America Universe]] and [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]] then took over “over 2 universes,” which caused [[multiverse-civil-war|a civil war]] that “the bad ones won.” [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]] then sent every universe except his favourite to [[shadow-realm|the Shadow Realm]].

sections.heading: Later references
sections.body:
- When [[kanye-west|Kanye]] and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] drop their mixtape, “across all multiverses, a wormhole opened at once.” (Plural multiverses, so there may be more than one.)
- The [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]] is held in “Cupertino, California, United Multiverses.”
- [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] says the [[inav|Inav]] was contracted by [[department-of-awesomeness|the Department of Awesomeness]] as a “universal navigator and transporter for the newly found multiverse.” The word “newly” suggests that either the Multiverse was rediscovered after the Snap, or Apple was very late.

title: The Cringe Universe
subtitle: A universe of nazis. LeBron did not approve.
lead: **The Cringe Universe** is the name this wiki uses for the universe that [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]] accidentally created while building [[multiverse|the Multiverse]]. It is described as a universe that was entirely nazis. (The book's exact wording is an offensive joke and is not reproduced here.) The name comes from [[lebron-james|LeBron James]]'s assessment of it: “nah bro thats cringe.”

sections.heading: History
sections.body:
LeBron sent [[baller-army|the Baller Army]] to “dab on the haters.” In the resulting [[baller-army-attack|attack]], “over 10 casualties were found and every nazi was dabbed on.” Afterward, “in that universe was the great oppression where the america universe took over” (see [[great-oppression|The Great Oppression]]).

Even after [[the-snap|the Snap]], its legacy continues: the Shadow Realm is a place where light does not exist and the nazi ants still exist.

sections.heading: Editorial note
sections.body: This article follows the wiki's content policy and describes the universe neutrally. Please do not add the book's original phrasing.

title: The America Universe
subtitle: Conqueror of universes. Enjoyer of funny ones.
lead: **The America Universe** is the imperial power of the early [[multiverse|Multiverse]]. It took over [[cringe-universe|the Cringe Universe]] in [[great-oppression|the Great Oppression]], and then: “But the america yerned for the minor miner universe because it was funny so together with elon musk they took over over 2 universes after which a civil war broke out and then the bad ones won.”

sections.heading: Analysis
sections.body: The America Universe is the only power in the canon whose foreign policy is driven by finding things funny. Editors note that “yerned” (yearned) is spelled the same way in all eight recitations. It is unclear whether the America Universe is connected to [[united-state-of-america|the United State of America]] where [[the-projects|the Projects]] are, or to the “united states of a america” of the [[baller-army|Baller Army]].

title: The Minor Miner Universe
subtitle: Funny.
lead:
**The Minor Miner Universe** is known for one thing only: “the america yerned for the minor miner universe because it was funny.” This yearning led [[america-universe|the America Universe]], with [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]], to take over “over 2 universes,” which triggered [[multiverse-civil-war|the Multiverse Civil War]].

The book does not say whether the Minor Miner Universe was among the universes taken, or what made it funny. The name may refer to underage miners, small miners, or both. The wiki has not reached consensus.

title: The Shadow Realm
subtitle: Where light doesn't exist and the universes go.

infobox.Inhabitants: Every universe but one; nazi ants; one nightclub room

quote.text: It seems like something happened with that usb drive, this room must've been sent to the shadow realm…

lead: **The Shadow Realm** is “a realm where light doesnt exist” and where the nazi ants left over from [[cringe-universe|the Cringe Universe]] “still exist.” It became the largest location in the canon by volume when [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]] snapped his fingers and “all the universes except for his fav were sent to the shadow realm.”

sections.heading: The Snap
sections.body: After [[multiverse-civil-war|the Multiverse Civil War]] ended badly, [[the-snap|the Snap]] sent essentially the entire [[multiverse|Multiverse]] to the Shadow Realm. Everything that happens later in the book therefore takes place either in Zuckerberg's favourite universe or inside the Shadow Realm, and the text never says which.

sections.heading: Emotions
sections.body: The Shadow Realm can feel. When [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] arrives on a glowing [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] at [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]] and apps begin downloading onto flip phones across the cosmos, “The Shadow Realm wept.”

sections.heading: Club Shadowban
sections.body: After the battle, the club was found abandoned and covered in dust, with only the outlines of feet remaining. Jobs concludes that, because of the [[zuck-tears-usb|Zuck Tears USB]], “this room must've been sent to the shadow realm.” This makes the club the second thing Zuckerberg has sent there, and the first one he did by crying. Gotham then begins disappearing, apparently for unrelated balling-based reasons.

sections.heading: The returning Elon
sections.body: In [[chapter-maybe-seventh|Chapter the Maybe Seventh]], ChatGPT warns that if the iPhone is rolled back from [[5g|5G]] to 3G at the last moment, “we have to deal with elon when we deal with chris, if hes coming straight from the shadow realm then who know what he'll want.” This is generally taken to mean [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]] or his “dormant twin.”

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- “Shadow Realm” is a phrase popularized by the *Yu-Gi-Oh!* anime, where losers of Shadow Games were banished.
- Related names include [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]] and the [[shadow-filtered-theater|Shadow-Filtered Theater]] in Cupertino. Whether the filter keeps the Shadow Realm out or lets it in is unknown.

title: Andromeda Galaxy
subtitle: Taken by Frodo.
lead:
The **Andromeda Galaxy** is the site of [[frodo|Frodo]]'s conquest. After [[the-snap|the Snap]], “frodo appeared deep in the universe and started a galactic take over of the andromeda galaxy.” The narrative then moves directly to Frodo cooking the whole universe with [[master-chef|Master Chef]]. Whether Andromeda was cooked with everything else, or was simply the kitchen, is unknown.

In the real world, Andromeda is the nearest large galaxy to the Milky Way, about 2.5 million light-years away. In this canon it was an appetizer.

title: Newark
subtitle: Birthplace of Chris.
lead:
**Newark** is the birthplace of [[chris|Chris]]. Each recitation of [[the-cycle|the Cycle]] ends: “Samwise then created chris and then he was born in newark.” The phrase “born in newark” appears eight times, making Newark one of the most frequently named places in the book.

Chris's birth here is followed immediately by [[stabbing-of-chris|his stabbing]] by [[ron-desantis|Ron DeSantis]]. The book does not say whether this also took place in Newark.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - In the real world, Newark is the largest city in New Jersey. The text does not specify which Newark is meant, but editors assume New Jersey.

title: The Dabbing of the Haters
subtitle: A hard one.

infobox.Belligerents: [[baller-army|Baller Army]] vs. the nazis of [[cringe-universe|the Cringe Universe]]

lead:
**The Dabbing of the Haters** was the first military action in [[multiverse|the Multiverse]]. It was ordered by [[lebron-james|LeBron James]] after he looked at [[cringe-universe|the Cringe Universe]] and judged it “cringe.”

The official account reads: “This attack was a hard one over 10 casualties were found and every nazi was dabbed on.” It is the only battle in the canon with a reported casualty count, and also the only one whose principal weapon is the dab. Historians note that “over 10” is a low figure for an operation against an entire universe, which they put down to how effective dabbing is.

title: The Great Oppression
subtitle: America takes over.
lead:
**The Great Oppression** followed [[baller-army-attack|the Dabbing of the Haters]]: “After this in that universe was the great oppression where the america universe took over” [[cringe-universe|the Cringe Universe]].

The book does not say who was oppressed or by how much. Since the conquered universe was made up entirely of nazis, the name has caused a good deal of debate on this wiki's talk pages. [[america-universe|The America Universe]] grew restless soon afterward and went looking for funnier universes.

title: The Multiverse Civil War
subtitle: The bad ones won.
lead:
**The Multiverse Civil War** broke out after [[america-universe|the America Universe]] and [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]] “took over over 2 universes.” The entire account of the war reads: “a civil war broke out and then the bad ones won.”

The sides, the reasons, and who the bad ones were are not recorded. The war ended when [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]] made the result irrelevant by sending every universe but his favourite to [[shadow-realm|the Shadow Realm]].

title: Zuckerberg's Snap
subtitle: All but one.
lead: **Zuckerberg's Snap** is the largest single event in the canon: “mark zuckerberg snapped his fingers and all the universes except for his fav were sent to the shadow realm, a realm where light doesnt exist.”

sections.heading: Analysis
sections.body: Zuckerberg's favourite universe is never named. Most editors assume it is the one where the rest of the book takes place, but it is also the universe that [[frodo|Frodo]] cooked and ate shortly afterward. If so, Zuckerberg's favourite universe lasted roughly one sentence.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The Snap references Thanos's snap in *Avengers: Infinity War* (2018), which wiped out half of all life. Zuckerberg's version affected considerably more than half.
- Later in the book, Zuckerberg's tears (via the [[zuck-tears-usb|Zuck Tears USB]]) appear to send [[club-shadowban|Club Shadowban]] to the same place.

title: The Cooking of the Universe
subtitle: Sirloin steak with lobster tail.
lead: **The Cooking of the Universe** was carried out by [[frodo|Frodo]] after his conquest of [[andromeda-galaxy|Andromeda]]: “he used master chef to cook the universe into a sirloin steak with lobster tail. Frodo then ate it and left the face of the universe never to be baller again.”

sections.heading: Analysis
sections.body:
The event raises several questions the wiki cannot answer:
- How Frodo left “the face of the universe” after eating it.
- Where everyone lived afterward. The text answers this only indirectly, with [[great-famine|the Great Famine]].
- Whether this was [[mark-zuckerberg|Zuckerberg]]'s favourite universe, the only one spared by [[the-snap|the Snap]].

The meal is the only surf and turf of cosmic scale in the canon.

title: The Great Famine
subtitle: There was no universe left to eat.
lead:
**The Great Famine** came after [[frodo|Frodo]] ate the universe: “After which there was a great famine and elon mush died of nfl poisoning.”

Given that the entire universe had just been eaten by one hobbit, editors consider the famine the most logically consistent event in [[the-cycle|the Cycle]]. Oddly, its only recorded victim died of something other than starvation. Its main political consequence was [[the-merging|the Merging]] of Elon Musk and LeBron James, possibly as a way to save on food.

title: NFL Poisoning
subtitle: Cause of death: football (somehow).
lead:
**NFL Poisoning** is the cause of death of [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]] during [[great-famine|the Great Famine]]. The book spells it “nfl poisoning” in four recitations of [[the-cycle|the Cycle]] and “nfl poisioning” in the other four, so both spellings are equally canonical.

What NFL poisoning is, and how one catches it, is never explained. Leading fan theories include contaminated stadium food (consistent with a famine), an overdose of football, and “NFL” standing for something else entirely. [[super-bowl|The Super Bowl]], the NFL's championship game, comes up later in the book as the only time Kanye leaves his house.

title: The Merging
subtitle: Musk + LeBron = Samwise.
lead: **The Merging** is the fusion of [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]] and [[lebron-james|LeBron James]] into [[samwise|Samwise]]: “Elon musk then merged with lebron james to become samwise.” It took place right after [[great-famine|the Great Famine]] and Elon Mush's death. Samwise's first act was to create [[chris|Chris]], which brings [[the-cycle|the Cycle]] back to its beginning.

sections.heading: Continuity
sections.body: Both men later appear separately: Musk in [[chapter-2|Chapter 2]], and both in [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]]. Either the Merging is reversible, or the Cycle resets it.

title: The Stabbing of Chris
subtitle: Homo-sapien.

quote.text: Then he was stabbed to death by Ron destantis claiming he was gay because he was a homo-sapien.

lead: **The Stabbing of Chris** is the event that ends [[the-cycle|the Cycle of Chris]] and opens [[chapter-2|Chapter 2]]. Right after [[chris|Chris]] is born in [[newark|Newark]], [[ron-desantis|Ron DeSantis]] stabs him to death. Ron's reasoning rests entirely on the word *homo sapiens*.

sections.heading: Placement
sections.body: The stabbing is recorded twice: first in the leak in the middle of the Cycle, after the fourth recitation, and then properly as the first sentence of Chapter 2, after the closing “9999999999999.” In both places the sentence begins with “Then,” connecting it directly to Chris's birth.

sections.heading: Aftermath
sections.body: Ron then starts [[quest-73-taco-bells|his quest for the 73 Taco Bell locations]] and never mentions Chris again. Chris does not stay dead: by [[chapter-triangle|Chapter Triangle]] he has committed war crimes, been cloned, and been traced to the [[reformed-travis-scott-sector|Reformed Travis Scott Sector]]. Editors list the stabbing as death number two, after the one he “balled from the grave” from.

title: The Quest for the 73 Taco Bell Locations
subtitle: Ongoing.
lead:
**The Quest for the 73 Taco Bell Locations** is the quest [[ron-desantis|Ron De Santis]] began right after [[stabbing-of-chris|stabbing Chris]]: “Ron De Santis then started his quest to find the 73 Taco bell locations.”

Why there are 73, why they had to be found, and whether any were found is never stated. Ron gets distracted almost at once by [[julian|Julian]] and [[war-for-byzantine-mexico|the War for Byzantine Mexico]]. Mexico is plausibly where one would look for tacos, so some editors argue the war was part of the quest.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Taco Bell turns up again indirectly when [[kanye-west|Kanye]] describes [[gotham-city|Gotham]] as “a city that looks like Hot Topic threw up on a Taco Bell.”

title: The War for Byzantine Mexico
subtitle: Long and hard.

infobox.Belligerents: [[ron-desantis|Ron DeSantis]], [[mark-zuckerberg|Mark Zuckerberg]], [[elon-musk|Elon Musk]] vs. [[byzantine-empire-of-mexico|the Byzantine Empire of Mexico]] (presumably)
infobox.Cause: Ron's refusal to make [[julian|Julian]] the native bird

lead: **The War for Byzantine Mexico** was fought after [[ron-desantis|Ron]] refused to make [[julian|Julian]] the native bird and “resorted to Mark zuckerberg and elon musk to take back the byzantine empire of mexico.”

sections.heading: The war
sections.body:
“The war was long and hard and ethereal green dotted existed for 0.0836 seconds in the middle of the war.” Meanwhile, [[truth-social|Truth Social]] was booming in [[soviet-union-of-north-korea|the Soviet Union of North Korea]].

“But the war was interrupted because medea from the hit play medea appeared out of her 4 dimensional tesseract dimension ship.” The war then turns into [[donkey-kong-racing-duel|the Donkey Kong Racing Duel]] and is never resumed.

sections.heading: Analysis
sections.body: The phrase “take back” implies that Ron, Zuckerberg or Musk had held the Byzantine Empire of Mexico before. No earlier ownership is recorded.

title: The Ethereal Green Dot
subtitle: 0.0836 seconds of existence.

infobox.Location: The middle of [[war-for-byzantine-mexico|the War for Byzantine Mexico]]

lead:
**The Ethereal Green Dot** is a phenomenon that appeared in the middle of [[war-for-byzantine-mexico|the War for Byzantine Mexico]]: “ethereal green dotted existed for 0.0836 seconds in the middle of the war.”

It has no cause, no effect, and no further mention. It is the most precisely timed event in a book that otherwise reports times like “14:74pm,” and the source text spells it “dotted,” which may make it a verb. Fan theories describe it as a laser sight, a glitch in [[the-cycle|the Cycle]], or a very brief online status indicator.

title: The Donkey Kong Racing Duel
subtitle: Loser finds Mic Q.

infobox.Game: “the hit video game donkey kong racing”

lead:
**The Donkey Kong Racing Duel** settled the dispute between [[jason|Jason]] and [[medea|Medea]] that interrupted [[war-for-byzantine-mexico|the War for Byzantine Mexico]]. “jason then dualed medea in the hit video game donkey kong racing, the punishment for the loser was to find mic Q.”

The result: “Jason lost but made medea look for mic Q anyway because “ha women”. Medea was never seen again.” Since [[mic-q|Mic Q]] cannot exist in any universe, the punishment can never be completed, and the duel has technically not finished.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- There is no real game called “Donkey Kong Racing.” Fans theorize it refers to *Diddy Kong Racing* (1997) or *Mario Kart*, in which Donkey Kong is a playable racer.
- The book's “dualed” is retained here as a canonical spelling of “duelled.”

title: Island of Logic and Retoric
subtitle: Seeking a native bird.
lead:
The **Island of Logic and Retoric** is mentioned once, as the place where [[joeius-bidenias|Joeius Bidenias]] wanted [[julian|Julian]] made “the native bird.” [[ron-desantis|Ron]] said no.

The island's main export is presumably logic and “retoric” (rhetoric). Given that Ron's response to the request was to start a war in Mexico, editors note the irony. The island currently has no native bird.

title: Byzantine Empire of Mexico
subtitle: Contested.
lead:
The **Byzantine Empire of Mexico** is the target of [[war-for-byzantine-mexico|Ron's war]], which he fought with Zuckerberg and Musk “to take back the byzantine empire of mexico.”

It belongs to the canon's broader Roman revival: [[canada|Canada]] has a Roman emperor, Zuckerberg's cigars come from “eastern rome,” and England reaches “a new level of Roman.” The historical Byzantine Empire was the Eastern Roman Empire, with its capital at [[constantinople|Constantinople]]. That city is later held by [[barack-empire|the Barack Empire]] and falls to [[goober-gang|the Goober Gang]]. Whether Byzantine Mexico and Constantinople are connected is a common fan theory, not a confirmed fact.

title: Canada (Roman)
subtitle: Ruled by a Roman emperor.
lead:
**Canada** in this canon is ruled by [[joeius-bidenias|Joeius Bidenias]], “the roman emperor of canada.” Canada's only recorded act of state is the emperor's review-bombing of something on [[imdb|IMDb]], followed by his demand that [[ron-desantis|Ron]] make [[julian|Julian]] the native bird of [[island-of-logic-and-retoric|the Island of Logic and Retoric]].

How Canada came under Roman rule is not explained. Neither is whether the Island of Logic and Retoric is Canadian territory, though the emperor's interest in its birds suggests it might be.

title: The Soviet Union of North Korea
subtitle: Truth Social boomtown.
lead: **The Soviet Union of North Korea** is a country where, during [[war-for-byzantine-mexico|the War for Byzantine Mexico]], “Truth social was at the time booming,” and which “was merging with the democratic Republic of the Chinese.”

sections.heading: Possible later appearance
sections.body: In [[chapter-triangle|Chapter Triangle]], the narration says “Meanwhile in the Soviet Union, lighting McQueen was getting sick of George Constanta,” after which [[lightning-mcqueen|McQueen]] flies to [[england|England]]. McQueen had moved in with Constanta after [[moscow-bombing|the attack on Moscow]], which the book places in Italy. Editors disagree on whether “the Soviet Union” refers to this country, to a separate Soviet Union, or to Moscow.

title: The Democratic Republic of the Chinese
subtitle: Merging.
lead:
**The Democratic Republic of the Chinese** is mentioned once, as the country that [[soviet-union-of-north-korea|the Soviet Union of North Korea]] “was merging with” while [[truth-social|Truth Social]] was booming there.

The merger's completion is never reported. Editors note that it is one of two mergers in the canon. The other produced [[samwise|Samwise]].

title: Medea's Tesseract Dimension Ship
subtitle: Four dimensions. At least.
lead:
**Medea's Tesseract Dimension Ship** is the vehicle from which [[medea|Medea]] “appeared out of her 4 dimensional tesseract dimension ship,” interrupting [[war-for-byzantine-mexico|the War for Byzantine Mexico]].

In geometry, a tesseract is already a four-dimensional hypercube, so the ship is triply specified as dimensional: 4 dimensional, tesseract, and dimension ship. Its fate after Medea left to search for [[mic-q|Mic Q]] is unknown. It is the earliest spacecraft in the canon, ahead of the [[mercedes-benz-system-cruiser|Mercedes Benz System Cruiser]] and the [[inav|Inav]].

title: "Ha Women"
subtitle: Jason's entire philosophy.
lead:
**“Ha women”** is the phrase [[jason|Jason]] uses, in quotation marks, to justify both of his actions in the canon:
- He “allowed all his descendants and crushes ever to be killed because “ha women”.”
- After losing [[donkey-kong-racing-duel|the Donkey Kong Racing Duel]], he “made medea look for mic Q anyway because “ha women”.”

The phrase explains nothing, which is the joke. The wiki records it as Jason's only stated reasoning and is not endorsing it. Editors point to the second use as a classic example of a sore loser.

title: IMDb
subtitle: Site of the review bomb.
lead:
**IMDb** is the platform where “a redditor left a 0.5 score on imdb and then it was reviewed bombed by joeius Bidenias the roman emperor of canada.” What was being reviewed is never specified.

The review bomb set off the chain of events leading to [[julian|Julian]]'s rejection and [[war-for-byzantine-mexico|the War for Byzantine Mexico]], which makes IMDb indirectly responsible for a war.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - In the real world, IMDb (the Internet Movie Database) only accepts whole-number ratings from 1 to 10. A score of 0.5 should not be possible.
